name: Donut chart
summary: Donut chart whose ring segments sweep in, with a big total in the hole and a legend with percentages.

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: color
params.note: first segment colour; default the style's accent

params.name: values
params.note: numbers; shares are computed from them

params.name: total
params.note: centre number; default is the sum of values

params.name: centerLabel
params.note: small text under the centre number

params.name: prefix
params.note: e.g. $ in front of the centre number

author: krakujs
